mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_agent_checkpoint (id, tenant_id, run_id, sequence, checkpoint_type, state_json, codec_version, checksum, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{sequence}, #{checkpointType}, #{stateJson}, #{codecVersion}, #{checksum}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ds_agent_checkpoint SET checkpoint_type = #{entity.checkpointType}, state_json = #{entity.stateJson}, codec_version = #{entity.codecVersion}, checksum = #{entity.checksum}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{entity.tenantId} AND run_id = #{entity.runId} AND sequence = #{entity.sequence}
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, run_id, sequence, checkpoint_type, state_json, codec_version, checksum, created_at, updated_at FROM ds_agent_checkpoint WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1
